summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new multi-curriculum feature. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_curricula.py (16 pytest cases, 16/16 PASS) covering GET /api/curricula (admin active=null, D2C child active=[financial_literacy]), admin topic/item curricula create+PUT persistence, invalid-curricula normalization, school curriculum PUT persistence + reflection in GET /api/admin/schools, non-admin 403 on the school PUT, and delivery scoping (D2C child cannot see ENT topic/content; admin sees everything; school-enabled ENT makes it visible; ?curriculum= filter returns only that curriculum's topics). Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): Admin Schools tab curriculum checkboxes persist with 'Curriculum access updated' toast and block removing the last curriculum; Content Management topic/subtopic/content dialogs all show data-testid='curricula-selector' with both options, topic selection persists after save + reload; Learn page shows no switcher for the D2C child and shows the switcher with All/FL/ENT tabs (each filtering correctly) for a child whose school has 2 curricula. ALL temporary data (test topics/items, school curricula, classmate_g1 school_id) was reverted - baseline verified: 88 topics, 25 items, both schools financial_literacy only, classmate_g1 has no school_id.

minor.issue: Docstring says 'Public list of all curricula' but the handler calls get_current_user() which raises 401 for anonymous callers. Works for all authenticated flows (LearnPage), but the endpoint is not public as documented - either wrap in try/except to return {curricula, active:[financial_literacy]} for anonymous, or fix the docstring.

ui_bugs.issue: Deselecting the last remaining curriculum silently re-selects Financial Literacy (onChange falls back to ['financial_literacy']) with no message. AdminPage's school toggle shows a clear 'A school must have at least one curriculum' toast; the content editor should show the same feedback so admins understand why their checkbox flipped back.

ui_bugs.component: LearnPage topic card (pre-existing, surfaced during ENT test)
ui_bugs.issue: A topic that has direct content items but ZERO subtopics is rendered with a green 'COMPLETE' badge even though the child completed nothing (get_all_topics sets is_completed from subtopic completion only, so a subtopic-less topic is vacuously complete). Not caused by the curriculum feature but will show up on any curriculum whose topics hold content directly.

issues: Tab buttons had no data-testid; added data-testid="admin-tab-{id}" for testability (only change made).

action_items: Optional: make GET /api/curricula tolerate anonymous callers (or correct the 'public' docstring).
Optional UX: show a 'At least one curriculum is required' toast in ContentManagement's CurriculaSelector instead of silently reverting to Financial Literacy.
Pre-existing bug worth fixing: topics with direct content items and no subtopics are marked COMPLETE on /learn regardless of child progress.
critical_code_review_comments: content_curricula_clause() treats missing/empty `curricula` as visible to EVERY curriculum. Today all 25 items are tagged, but any future item saved without the field will leak into every curriculum (including money_entrepreneurship-only schools). Consider defaulting legacy/missing docs to financial_literacy instead of matching all.

?curriculum= override is correctly ignored when the requested id is not in the user's active list (no leakage) - good; note admins cannot use the filter at all since active_curricula is None for them (admin Learn view is unscoped).
ContentManagement.jsx is ~2490 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline; the curricula selector work is fine but the file should be split.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defect found in the multi-curriculum feature. The only earlier red flag (an extra topic appearing under ?curriculum=money_entrepreneurship) was traced to a leftover test topic from an aborted fixture run, not to the filter logic; after cleanup the filter returned exactly one topic.
